key_insight: The classical communication cost of simulating quantum state transmission equals that of simulating prepare-and-broadcast quantum correlations, growing exponentially with quantum dimension and as a power law in inverse noise.
engineering_relevance: Classical complexity provides a resource benchmark for quantum communication advantage and tools to certify it in quantum preparation devices.
method: Define minimum-cost classical communication models for quantum preparations.
Prove resource equivalence with prepare-and-broadcast correlation simulation.
Certify complexity using semidefinite programming, analytical witnesses and scalable convex programming.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical scaling results, an exact semidefinite-programming characterisation and convex methods scalable to hundreds and sometimes thousands of qubit states.
watch_item: The abstract does not report hardware validation, and practical certification costs may depend on the preparation set and noise model.
paper_title: The classical complexity of quantum state transmission
